How do I ensure I'm buying a real account on iGV?

iGV Verified: Every account listed on iGV goes through a strict verification process during both listing and delivery, ensuring 100% authenticity. When purchasing, look for the "Verified" badge on the listing — this guarantees the account information is accurate and the seller has been vetted by our team.

How do I receive my account details after purchase?

Once your payment is confirmed, your account details will be sent to your registered iGV email address or the shipping email provided at checkout within 5 minutes. You can also log into your iGV account and view the information directly under "Messages." If you haven't received anything after 5 minutes, please contact the seller via "My Orders" or reach out to our customer support team.

What should I do if there is a problem with my account after purchase?

Step 1: Log into iGV, go to "Order Center," and locate the order in question. Step 2: Use "Contact Seller" to resolve the issue directly, or click "Request Refund" to initiate the after-sales process. Step 3: The seller has 48 hours to respond. If no response is received, iGV will automatically process a refund to protect your rights. Step 4: If the seller disputes the refund and the issue remains unresolved, you may escalate by filing a dispute. iGV's customer service team will investigate and ensure a fair outcome for every buyer.
